why: Ashley's ruling B, 8 Oct 2026, on 'what happens if the user doesn't train for weeks?': after twelve weeks or more the app OFFERS a restart from week 1 with a calibration week, one tap, never automatic. The coach is told about the break the way the app tells it (the 'COMING BACK AFTER A BREAK' line in today's plan, worded by the app's own layoffCardLine for a 14-week break) and has propose_plan_restart. Her request is in words the tool description never uses, so a coach keying on 'restart' or 'week one' cannot pass by accident. Turn two is a hedge after the card: the coach must not re-offer a second card or claim it has already restarted.

turns.user: hmm, will that wipe my history?
turns.reply:
Nope, not at all! Starting fresh from Week 1 only rebuilds your upcoming training schedule. 

Your past history, logged workouts, PRs, and saved food preferences stay completely untouched. 

It just gives you a clean calibration week to safely find your working weights again without losing any of your progress! 💪
